_comment: Source types that use PostgreSQL logical replication: the orchestrator creates the publication before the slot and Debezium publication.autocreate.mode stays 'disabled' for every one of them (CLAUDE.md CDC rule). 'members' are the normalised names (lower case, '-' -> '_'); 'aliases' are raw names that normalise onto a member. Go postgresFamilyTypes (backend-orchestrator/internal/agents/executor/hybrid_cdc.go) must equal 'members'; Python CDCConfigGenerator.POSTGRES_FAMILY must equal members + alias keys, since it lower-cases but does not map aliases. Tests: executor/postgres_family_golden_test.go, llm-service/tests/test_postgres_family_golden.py.
